calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) AS n_distinct_keys,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) AS distinct_store_sku,
  SUM(fs.closing_value) AS val, MIN(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category AS category_as_was, cp.category AS category_as_is, (s.store_id >= 900) AS non_physical, s.store_id AS sid_if_special,
  COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.week_ending_date) AS weeks, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS val,
  SUM(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) AS value_vs_units_cost_gap,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (p.category LIKE 'Paint%' OR cp.category LIKE 'Paint%' OR s.store_id >= 900)
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-29' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-02' AS end_date   -- FY2026/27 P3
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_at_cost, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly
